verdict.rationale: Orb documents managed daily exports of resource types to a destination of your choice, and cursor-paginated list endpoints that could be used to pull records out. The evidence does not confirm that subscriptions, invoices, and usage events are all covered, and nothing addresses porting stored payment methods to another provider. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that subscriptions, invoices and raw usage are all exportable, any payment-method portability or token-migration path, an exit/offboarding guide, and independent corroboration.
